	# holy site special building slots - check faith (fragile/check-debug)
	if = {
		limit = { has_special_building_slot = no scope:halfsade_target_barony = { is_holy_site = yes } }
		debug_log = "halfsade: holy site barony has no slot, looking up its faith"
		scope:halfsade_target_barony = {
			random_barony_holy_site = {
				random_holy_site_faith = { save_scope_as = halfsade_holy_faith }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:halfsade_holy_faith }
			debug_log = "halfsade: faith found, calling the vanilla holy site slot effect"
			add_holy_site_fallback_special_building_slot_effect = { FAITH = scope:halfsade_holy_faith }
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "halfsade: holy site faith lookup FAILED, no faith saved"
		}
	}
	# unknown special building slots (fragile/check-debug)
	if = {
		limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
		debug_log = "halfsade: nothing identified the slot, using the generic_university fallback"
		debug_log_scopes = yes
		add_special_building_slot = generic_university
	}
}
